title: 化学灼伤与眼部急救
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/160_化学灼伤与眼部急救.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/160_化学灼伤与眼部急救/src.py

points.K3: 大面积：喷淋下边冲边脱
points.K4: 帮忙的人：带去冲、护自己

shots.scene: 欣欣站在洗眼器和水槽之间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between an eyewash station and a lab sink, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第14章第六课：化学灼伤与眼部急救。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一滴水的图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a big water drop icon with a stopwatch beside it.
shots.narration: 化学品沾身入眼，第一件事就是水。

shots.scene: 阿杰转移酸液，液体溅起
shots.prompt_en: In a university chemistry lab, the young male student pours liquid from a bottle into a beaker and some splashes up toward his face and arm.
shots.narration: 阿杰倒溶液时，液体溅了起来。

shots.prompt_en: The young male student grimaces, holding his wet sleeve and lifting a hand toward one eye.
shots.narration: 手臂刺痛，他下意识想揉眼睛。

shots.scene: 小研喊住他，扶他去冲洗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls out and guides him quickly toward the eyewash station and sink.
shots.narration: 小研喊：别揉！马上去冲！

shots.scene: 老周拿起试剂瓶看标签
shots.prompt_en: The older man picks up the reagent bottle and checks its label, holding a safety data sheet.
shots.narration: 老周拿起试剂瓶，查看标签。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person splashed with liquid shouting for help, sound waves, people turning toward him. No text.
shots.narration: 被溅到，别慌，先大声呼救。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person rubbing an eye, wiping skin with a paper towel and waiting, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别揉别擦，也别等。

shots.scene: 三条路：水槽、喷淋、洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three arrows from a splashed person to a lab sink, an emergency shower sign and an eyewash sign. No text.
shots.narration: 按溅到的部位，选择冲洗的地方。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large stream of clean running water flowing over skin. No text.
shots.narration: 用大量流动清水，立即冲洗。

shots.scene: 进门先认洗眼器和喷淋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student at a lab door looking toward an eyewash sign and an emergency shower sign on the wall. No text.
shots.narration: 平时就要知道洗眼器喷淋在哪。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rinsed person with a towel, an arrow to a supervisor icon and a phone with an ambulance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 冲洗后报告负责人，严重拨120。

shots.scene: 【实拍】前臂伸到水槽龙头下大量冲水
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a forearm held under a fully opened lab sink tap, a large stream of clean water running over it.
shots.narration: 溅到手和前臂，到水槽大量冲水。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wet lab coat sleeve clinging to the forearm, a warning mark. No text.
shots.narration: 袖子湿透了，化学品还贴着皮肤。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper with gloves cutting open a wet sleeve with blunt scissors. No text.
shots.narration: 脱掉或剪开袖子，再接着冲。

shots.scene: 水槽冲不干净，转去喷淋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow from a small sink to an emergency shower sign. No text.
shots.narration: 范围大、冲不干净，就用喷淋。

shots.section_title: 大面积：喷淋下边冲边脱
shots.scene: 化学品大面积泼到身上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: liquid splashing across a person's chest and legs, a warning mark. No text.
shots.narration: 大面积沾染，马上到紧急喷淋下。
overlay: 大面积：喷淋下边冲边脱

shots.section_title: 大面积：喷淋下边冲边脱
shots.scene: 在喷淋下边冲边脱外衣
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person standing under an emergency shower taking off a lab coat while water pours down. No text.
shots.narration: 在水下边冲，边脱去污染衣物。

shots.section_title: 大面积：喷淋下边冲边脱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: shoes, socks, a watch and a ring placed aside on the floor away from the shower. No text.
shots.narration: 鞋袜、手表、首饰，都要去掉。

shots.section_title: 大面积：喷淋下边冲边脱
shots.scene: 小心摘下护目镜，别把污染带进眼
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hands carefully lifting off splashed goggles away from the face, eyes closed. No text.
shots.narration: 摘护目镜要小心，别带进眼睛。

shots.section_title: 大面积：喷淋下边冲边脱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person hugging a soaked lab coat and refusing to take it off, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别顾面子，别让湿衣服贴着皮肤。

shots.section_title: 大面积：喷淋下边冲边脱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: contaminated clothes placed into a sealed bag with a hazard label, a trash bin icon for highly toxic items. No text.
shots.narration: 脱下的衣物先去污，剧毒的直接废弃。

shots.section_title: 帮忙的人：带去冲、护自己
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper putting on gloves and goggles before reaching the splashed person. No text.
shots.narration: 帮忙前，先戴好手套和护目镜。
overlay: 帮忙的人：带去冲、护自己

shots.section_title: 帮忙的人：带去冲、护自己
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two helpers guiding a person under an emergency shower, water soaking from head to toe. No text.
shots.narration: 主动把他带到水下，从头冲到脚。

shots.section_title: 帮忙的人：带去冲、护自己
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper holding up a blanket as a screen beside the shower, spare clothes ready on a chair. No text.
shots.narration: 拿屏风毛毯遮挡，备好替换衣服。

shots.section_title: 帮忙的人：带去冲、护自己
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one helper stays beside the rinsing person while another calls on a phone with an ambulance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 一人陪着冲，一人去呼叫急救。

shots.section_title: 帮忙的人：带去冲、护自己
shots.scene: 帮忙者自己也冲洗换衣
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the helper with wet gloves rinsing his own hands and changing a wet coat. No text.
shots.narration: 自己沾到了，也要冲洗、换衣。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: white powder on the back of a hand, a warning mark. No text.
shots.narration: 干的化学品粉末落到皮肤上。

shots.scene: 【实拍】用卡片轻轻扫去手背上的模拟粉末
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a gloved hand uses a stiff card to gently brush white powder off the back of another hand into a tray.
shots.narration: 先轻轻扫掉大部分粉末。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the hand moved under running tap water after brushing, the card set aside for cleaning. No text.
shots.narration: 再用大量清水冲，用过的卡片洗净。

shots.scene: 酸碱沾到皮肤，往上涂另一种溶液，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bottle being poured onto a burned skin patch to neutralize it, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别在皮肤上中和，会放热加重伤。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: toothpaste, oil and an ointment tube near a chemical burn, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不涂牙膏油脂，不乱抹药膏。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: plain running water flowing over skin with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 先脱去污染衣物，只用大量清水冲。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rinsed hand with a towel, an arrow to a supervisor icon. No text.
shots.narration: 冲完报告负责人，带说明书就医。

shots.scene: 眼睛刺痛，不知道进了什么
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person squinting with one watering eye, a question mark beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 眼睛不舒服，不知道是什么也先冲。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper guiding a person with closed eyes to the nearest eyewash station. No text.
shots.narration: 第一时间赶到最近的洗眼器。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two gentle low streams rising from an eyewash bowl. No text.
shots.narration: 洗眼器水流柔和、连续，不伤眼。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person with tightly closed eyes over an eyewash, water only hitting the eyelids, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 闭着眼冲，水根本进不去。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: fingers holding the upper and lower eyelids open over the eyewash streams. No text.
shots.narration: 用手指撑开眼睑，让水冲进眼里。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eye looking up, down, left and right under gentle water, arrows around the eyeball. No text.
shots.narration: 转动眼球，眼睑下面也要冲到。

shots.scene: 【实拍】只溅到一只眼，伤眼朝下侧头冲
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a person tilts the head sideways at a sink so a gentle stream runs over one eye from the inner corner outward, the other eye higher.
shots.narration: 只溅到一只眼，伤眼朝下侧着冲。

shots.scene: 水流把污染带进另一只眼，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: water running from one eye across the nose into the other eye, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别让水把污染带进另一只眼。

shots.scene: 【实拍】冲洗中用干净手指取下隐形眼镜
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a clean finger gently slides a soft contact lens off the eye during rinsing, water still running.
shots.narration: 戴隐形眼镜的，冲洗中尽早取下。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student wearing chemical splash goggles at the bench, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 护目镜一直戴着，最好的急救是不出事。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person leaving the eyewash after a few seconds with a short stopwatch icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 冲几秒觉得不疼就停，不行。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cross section of skin with chemical drops seeping into deeper layers. No text.
shots.narration: 化学品会渗进组织，伤害来得慢。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: water running continuously over an eye with a clock icon showing a long time. No text.
shots.narration: 持续冲洗足够时间，不凭感觉停。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: after the emergency shower, an arrow to a changing room shower where rinsing continues. No text.
shots.narration: 初步冲淋后，可到更衣室接着冲。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two short water icons adding up to one long stopwatch icon. No text.
shots.narration: 前后加起来，要冲足时间。

shots.scene: 说明书第四部分急救措施
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety data sheet with the first aid section highlighted by a cross icon. No text.
shots.narration: 说明书里写着专门的急救措施。

shots.scene: 个别化学品冲洗后还要专门处理
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bottle with a corrosion pictogram and a skull pictogram, an arrow to a special first aid kit and a hospital icon. No text.
shots.narration: 个别化学品，冲洗后还要专门处理。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bottle with a skull pictogram, an arrow to an ambulance. No text.
shots.narration: 如氢氟酸，按说明书处置，立即就医。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student reading a safety data sheet before an experiment and placing a special first aid item on the shelf. No text.
shots.narration: 实验前查好说明书，备好用品和预案。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person coughing and dizzy near an open bottle with vapor rising. No text.
shots.narration: 吸入后不舒服，先离开到通风处。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the person telling a classmate and a supervisor icon what happened. No text.
shots.narration: 告诉同伴和负责人，别一个人扛。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person with worsening symptoms, an arrow to a hospital icon. No text.
shots.narration: 症状加重或拿不准，及时就医。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a swallowed chemical icon with a hand at the throat to vomit crossed out, an arrow to a hospital. No text.
shots.narration: 误食了不催吐，立即就医。

shots.scene: 冲完觉得没事就回去实验，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rinsed person going back to the bench with a smile, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 冲洗只是急救，不能代替治疗。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock icon and an eye that turns red hours later. No text.
shots.narration: 不疼也别拖，有的伤害会延迟出现。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow from a rinsed eye to a hospital icon with an eye symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 冲洗后尽快就医，眼伤看眼科。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone with an ambulance icon, a person with a towel waiting. No text.
shots.narration: 伤情严重，马上拨打120。

shots.scene: 老周拿着SDS和标签照片陪同就医
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds a safety data sheet and a phone showing a photo of the bottle label, walking with the young male student.
shots.narration: 就医带上说明书或标签照片。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a doctor icon listening, a bottle icon, a clock icon and a water drop icon. No text.
shots.narration: 说清接触了什么、多久、怎么处理。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a doctor icon reading a safety data sheet, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 医生知道是什么，才能对症处理。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone with arrows to a supervisor icon and a school building icon. No text.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人和学院。

shots.scene: 每用一次洗眼器都要记录
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eyewash icon next to a blank report form with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 每用一次洗眼器喷淋，都要报告。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a water drop icon, a stopwatch icon and an open eye icon. No text.
shots.narration: 立即用大量清水冲，冲够时间。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of removing a wet coat, fingers opening eyelids and a neutralizing bottle crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 脱去污染衣物，撑开眼睑，不中和。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety data sheet with an arrow to a hospital icon and a report form. No text.
shots.narration: 带上说明书就医，及时报告。

shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank report form with a small warning icon and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：事故与未遂事件报告。
